# Lab 10.1: External Tables on Cloud Storage

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a permanent external table and a temporary external table over files in Cloud Storage, and see what external tables cannot do.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create the dataset.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab10
export BUCKET=$PROJECT_ID-bq-labs
gcloud storage ls gs://$BUCKET/formats/parquet/</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   This uses the Parquet files from Lab 3.2.

2. **[SQL] Permanent external table.** Replace `YOUR_BUCKET`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE lab10.names_ext
OPTIONS (
  format = 'PARQUET',
  uris = ['gs://YOUR_BUCKET/formats/parquet/names-*']
);

SELECT state, SUM(number) AS babies FROM lab10.names_ext GROUP BY state ORDER BY babies DESC LIMIT 5;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[CLI] Temporary external table for one query.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
  --external_table_definition=tmp_names::PARQUET=gs://$BUCKET/formats/parquet/names-* \
  'SELECT gender, SUM(number) AS babies FROM tmp_names GROUP BY gender'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   `tmp_names` exists only for this one query. Nothing is created in the dataset.

4. **[Console] See the limits.** Open `names_ext`:
   - **Preview** is not available.
   - The dry-run estimate shows **0 B** or an unknown size, because BigQuery cannot estimate file sizes ahead of time.
   - Try `DELETE FROM lab10.names_ext WHERE TRUE;` and it fails: external tables are read-only.

5. **[CLI] Change the files and query again.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage rm "gs://$BUCKET/formats/parquet/names-000000000000"
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab10.names_ext'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The count changes at once. External tables always read the current files.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Data location | Stays in Cloud Storage |
| Freshness | Always current files |
| Limits | No preview, no DML, no cache, slower |
| Temporary table | Defined inside one `bq query` |
